entries.subject: Zubarev and Nadezhdina (2025) mosaic and DEM
entries.finding: Zubarev and Nadezhdina's 2025 paper, [Shape, mosaic and control point network](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.icarus.2024.116440), reports a newer 50 m/pixel mosaic and DEM in a new reference frame. Its public downloadable pixel/model release was not located from the paper and linked 2025 LPSC abstract. The research exists; this package does not claim to include it.
entries.revisitWhen: Its pixel or model release becomes publicly downloadable.

entries.subject: Cassini clear frames with the PDS controlled shape and camera release
entries.finding: Cassini calibrated clear-filter frames and the PDS controlled shape and camera release provide restorable imagery with an explicit common registration frame and a conceptually distinct global-relief view.

entries.subject: USGS Voyager control network map
entries.finding: The [USGS Voyager control network](https://astrogeology.usgs.gov/search/map/hyperion_image_control_network) has a four-frame high-pass-filtered Voyager map. It is much coarser than the selected Cassini data and uses an older frame; it is not an extra lens.
entries.revisitWhen: It offers finer coverage than Cassini in this model's frame.

entries.subject: NASA Hyperion 3D model
entries.finding: NASA's [Hyperion 3D model](https://science.nasa.gov/resource/hyperion-3d-model/) is a useful visualization but its small UV atlas has no delivered per-pixel observational coverage or controlled frame. It is not relabeled as an observation or used to fill gaps in measured imagery.
entries.revisitWhen: Its texture is released with per-pixel observational coverage and a controlled frame.

entries.subject: NASA press mosaics
entries.finding: NASA press mosaics provide excellent regional images but do not publish a single projection/camera model for the composited pixels. The original controlled ISS frames are used instead. Available enhanced-color press views are not treated as a registered global color dataset.
entries.revisitWhen: A composited product publishes its projection or camera model.

entries.subject: Cassini ISS frame N1513999046 in the Monochrome lens
entries.finding: Its published camera places 36% of the lit source shape on the photograph's sky, above the 25% at which preparation refuses a frame.
entries.revisitWhen: A corrected camera or pointing solution for the frame registers it with interior holdouts.

entries.subject: N1506393778 high-resolution regional frame
entries.finding: The published table has two camera rows for N1506393778_1, while current OPUS supplies calibrated version N1506393778_2. One published center is off-chip, which is possible for a regional image. Both fixed-camera trials against the existing N1506391424 reference failed with Insufficient independent feature patches; neither reached residual qualification. The nominal roughly 21 m/pixel opportunity remains unresolved, rather than being positioned by eye.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent controlled registration establishes the correct native product and camera row, including image coverage outside the body center.
